name: zocial-world
description: Zocial World — a browser-based 3D social world for the Zcash community (monorepo root).

scripts.dev:main:web: node scripts/dev/with-env.mjs VITE_ZCASH_NETWORK=main -- npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev:main:server: node scripts/dev/with-env.mjs ZCASH_NETWORK=main -- npm run dev:local-voice --workspace apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:server && npm run test:scripts
